_comment: Each member but this one is the secrets broker's answer to a token check that reached no verdict because the key set of the token's issuer could not be read, one of each shape a client reads: json_route a JSON route's (POST /v1/oauth/introspect with the caller's own token), token_endpoint the token endpoint's (POST /v1/oauth/token, a pod's token exchange), hold_route a route of the NATS writer hold's (GET /v1/nats-hold with the operator's token). Each holds the request, the status, the Retry-After and Content-Type headers, and the body, at the default spacing of a key set's failed reads (5 s). internal/cipher/api's TestTheUnreadableKeySetAnswersAreTheFixture writes this file from the broker's real HTTP server when UPDATE_UNREADABLE_KEY_SET_ANSWERS=1 is set, and fails in every other run where the server answers otherwise. A client's test replays the answer of its shape (internal/cipher/api/unreadablekeysettest), setting its own Retry-After where its row is about another wait. Each body is the broker's bytes as JSON: the white space between its tokens is free, and the newline the broker's encoder ends it with is left out. No body carries a value of its own request, so nothing in one is replaced: the answer id is in the X-Broker-Answer-Id header, which this file does not hold, and the broker adds answer_id to a 4xx body only, never to a 503's.

body.error: the broker could not check the token, because its issuer's key set could not be read: send it again after Retry-After

body.error_description: ISSUER_UNAVAILABLE: the broker could not check the subject or actor token, because its issuer's key set could not be read: send it again after Retry-After

body.message: the broker could not check the caller's token, because its issuer's key set could not be read: send it again after Retry-After
